page.overview:
Who is Aviemore station master?

This individual worked as the station master at Aviemore train station in 1981. He spoke in very strong Scots.

After inadvertently being brought back in time to 1981 by Delphini, wand-less and broom-less Albus Potter and Scorpius Malfoy walked from the Hogwarts grounds to Aviemore train station. There, they learned from the oblivious station master that it was the day before Lord Voldemort went to Godric's Hollow in the West Country, killed James and Lily Potter, failed to kill their son and Albus's father Harry, and triggered Voldemort's first downfall, and the two boys journeyed to Godric's Hollow to prevent Delphini from changing history.
